subject: reasoning
question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

306 ÷ 17 + 4 - 50 × 8 = 30
solution:
__BODMAS Rule:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Option 1) + and -

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __306 ÷ 17__ - 4 + 50 × 8 = 30

⇒ 18 - 4 +__ 50 × 8 __= 30

⇒ __18__ - 4 __+ 400__ = 30

⇒ 418 - 4 = 30

⇒ 414 ≠ 30

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) ÷ and ×

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ 306 × 17 + 4 - __50 ÷ 8 __= 30

⇒ __306 × 17 __+ 4 - 6.25 = 30

⇒ __5205 + 4 __- 6.25 = 30

⇒__ 5209 - 6.25__ = 30

⇒ 5202.75 ≠ 30

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) × and -

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __306 ÷ 17__ + 4 × 50 - 8 = 30

⇒ 18 + __4 × 50__ - 8 = 30

⇒ __18 + 200__ - 8 = 30

⇒ __218 - 8__ = 30

⇒ 210 ≠ 30

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) + and × 

After interchanging the sign we get:

⇒ __306 ÷ 17__ × 4 - 50 + 8 = 30

⇒ __18 × 4__ - 50 + 8 = 30

⇒ __72 __- 50 __+ 8__ = 30

⇒ __80 - 50__ = 30

⇒ 30 = 30

⇒ LHS = RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
